messages.content: I need a refund NOW. The product I received is nothing like the description. This is unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear about your experience. I'd like to help you with the refund. Could you please provide me with your order number?
It's order #12345. Can we make this quick? I've already wasted enough time.
I can see your order #12345 for the Radiance Serum ($45.00). I'll start the refund process for you right away.
Finally. How long will this take? I want my money back immediately.
The refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. You'll receive a confirmation email once it's done.
3-5 days? That's too long but fine. I'm done here. Goodbye.
